attributes.name: Poison Spiked Pit Trap
attributes.powers:
The difficulty to defeat is increased by the scenario's adventure deck number.

If undefeated, each character at this location is dealt 1d4 Combat damage, then 1d4 Poison damage, then end your turn.

If defeated, you may explore your location.

corrections.corrected_text: On the barrier Poison Spiked Pit Trap, change the last power to "If undefeated, each character at this location is dealt 1d4 Combat damage, then 1d4 Poison damage, then end your turn."
